anchor_family: open cut rings, offset slabs, and progressively reduced stepped fields
trace_family: single charcoal return arcs and measured course-correction paths
echo_family: sparse short bars and small nodes that change density along the trace
void_behavior: large off-center apertures and interrupted paths that hold uncertainty or missing knowledge
texture: very light dry-screenprint speckle confined to the mineral-blue anchor only; quiet flat background
recurring_motif: two short registration ticks beside the decisive turn in each composition
notes: The series translates learning as recursive observation, course correction, and support that gradually fades into independent action. Keep 55-75% quiet space and no embedded text.
